note: The caption 'Figure 4.4 Broad classification of Kingdom Animalia based on common fundamental features' and the footnote '*Echinodermata exhibits radial or bilateral symmetry depending on the stage.' are printed below target_box_in_crop (outside it) so were excluded; also excluded the running header (40, BIOLOGY) and body text below. This is a branching classification tree: the five column headers come first, then labels follow the tree branches left to right (Animalia -> Cellular level -> mostly asymmetrical -> acoelomata -> Porifera; Animalia -> Tissue/Organ/Organ system -> Radial -> acoelomata -> Coelenterata (Cnidaria), Ctenophora; -> Bilateral -> Without body cavity (acoelomates) -> Platyhelminthes; With false coelom (pseudocoelomates) -> Aschelminthes; With true coelom (coelomates) -> Annelida, Arthropoda, Mollusca, *Echinodermata, Hemichordata, Chordata). The flat list cannot represent the branching structure or which column each label belongs to.
